author: ezpzxd
quote:
Good, Bad & a lot of ugly
GOOD: Insane rich environment, the map/world is next level, offers hope for Online
BAD:    uff... worst GTA campaign in history
UGLY: the main cast & 99% of the characters are horrible!!! generic AF, forgetable, no personality, uninteresting & not funny. 
Jayson is as boring/blend as it gets and Lucia is an annoying **** brat stereotype turned 5'0 all gyatt supergirl whopping 6'4 special force operators and the combination and dynamic of the two belong into a SIMS not GTA. 
Pete and Cal are about the only GTA-worthy characters. 
Devs & Creative Director seem to have forgotten what makes GTA.... GTA
lack of creativity goes for missions as well - besides the safe mission...most of them are super boring and get carried by the environment and some epic shoot out here and there. If this was a school project: F – didn't understand the ASSessment (get it? bc that seems what most dev focus went into)
With Online tbr and the world being well done: final review will prob land around 7-8 (might be high for a game, but disappointment for a GTA)

GTA VI feels more like a product than an iconic piece of pop culture.
